reference_intent: Match the approved Isabel office composition while keeping the camera deterministic as Isabel moves.
lock_rules: Camera transform never follows Isabel during normal office behavior.
Office objects are never moved to compensate for camera framing after geometry lock.
Only focal length, transform, and crop may be tuned during camera calibration.
Final calibration values must be written back to this file after approval.
No AI image regeneration is used to correct composition.
quality_gates: All four monitors are fully visible and remain 16:9.
Isabel is visible at the desk without blocking the monitor group.
Left windows read clearly as a continuous daylight wall.
Floor and ceiling are both visible enough to preserve room depth.
No wide-angle distortion makes furniture or window frames bow unnaturally.
